contentText: In tonight’s edition, violence continues in northern Nigeria, with killings and kidnappings reported in Sokoto State. Also, the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) accuses Ethiopia’s government of violating the Pretoria peace deal that ended the 2020-2022 war, which killed hundreds of thousands. And at Paris Perfume Week, Ghana’s first artisan perfumer is putting African roots at the forefront, redefining luxury fragrance from the source.
